summary: Saved selected-box recount and checkpoint-content preservation are verified. No blocking integrity defect was found within the stated scope. Scalar-only diagnostics, single-run causal limits, dormant DIoU code, and unverified cold recovery require qualifications.
model_attribution_note: Requested model/effort come from the experiment-audit/local Codex policy contract. This reviewer has no runtime metadata attesting actual model or effort; no cross-family acceptance is claimed.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: ScanRefer annotation object IDs identify ScanNet objects. Dataset boxes and masks come from dataset object points, and validation disables training augmentation. The diagnostic root_gt_box reads center_label/size_gts slot0. Neither selected predictions nor mask-derived endpoints are used as GT. Native bbs ranking uses the existing parsed text maps; root box/mask GT is used for scoring/diagnostics. This is verification of the repository native protocol, not external certification against an independently run official benchmark implementation.

B_score_normalization.details: The formal denominator is 9508 dataset records. Accuracy is hits/9508, and box IoU is intersection/(prediction volume + GT volume - intersection). Strict >0.25 and >0.5 decisions were independently reproduced; no threshold disagreement or above-one logged selected IoU was found. Semantic softmax supplies candidate scores, not a prediction-derived denominator for formal accuracy. Mask support uses 2*intersection>union, a strict0.5 rule.

C_result_existence_and_identity.details: All required primary files exist. ct3 intake files match their size/SHA records; original compressed payloads decompress byte-for-byte to the local rows; ct3 and e2v2 terminal statuses agree. Independent scalar IoU reproduces every submitted CSV value and all claimed hit/repair/break totals. Checkpoint/witness/archive/retirement joins pass. Earlier pending fields remain historical facts; this audit adds later evidence without changing the original receipts.

D_call_chain_and_dead_code.details: The claimed path is connected: controller invokes train_dist_mod; BaseTrainTester evaluates E0 and each completed epoch; evaluate_one_epoch invokes _main_eval_branch, native GroundingEvaluator.evaluate and diagnostics.append/finish. GroundingEvaluator dispatches bbs to evaluate_bbox_by_pos_align; native_root_bbs reproduces its root text-score definition for diagnostics. Saved rows and metric agreement bind the diagnostic path. The unclaimed DIoU helper is dormant; no result is attributed to it.

E_scope_and_claims.details: One control configuration, one seed2027, 141 validation scenes, 2068 scene-target pairs and 9508 records/evaluation; E0 plus E1/E2. Retained best remains E0. Two strict Acc@0.5 declines support the recorded stop. Saved strategy evidence is an admitted-child snapshot with no completed metric. Full256 coverage/mask support cannot be independently reconstructed from this compact record. No robustness, new-best, strategy improvement, causal attribution, or goal-completion claim is justified.

F_evaluation_type.details: Formal bbs accuracy and saved endpoint IoU comparisons use dataset GT. Candidate-coverage values are GT-referenced oracle diagnostics, not deployed accuracy; prediction-derived native/mask boxes remain predictions. The supplemental matcher note is source/algebraic analysis, not an additional runtime evaluation.

warnings.title: Saved-box verification has explicit raw-data and candidate limits
warnings.details: The audit recomputed selected final/native/mask-endpoint IoU from saved coordinates. Raw ScanRefer/ScanNet objects, point clouds, masks, 256 candidate boxes/logits, and original matching assignments were not reloaded. Coverage, qualified counts/ranks, and mask support use recorded scalars. Input fingerprint equality is checked from saved hashes, not by recomputing hashes of raw arrays.

warnings.title: Content preservation is distinct from original byte copy and cold recovery
warnings.details: The retained artifact reconstructs the original E0 state using identical protected model tensors and the original non-model payload. It has a different ZIP hash and length from the retired original. No model construction, strict architecture reload, forward replay, or normal training continuation was executed. The audited normal main explicitly rejects checkpoint resume. The losing E2 latest was intentionally not archived.

warnings.title: One control run does not establish a causal mechanism or strategy benefit
warnings.details: Scope is one ScanRefer validation setting, seed 2027, E0 and two completed training epochs. Endpoint comparisons are observational comparisons at the selected slot, not retrained module ablations. Coverage gaps, support-qualified errors, and a source responsibility table do not prove the source of decline, extra-loss eligibility, or effectiveness of the selected-geometry strategy. Strategy intake supplied here has no completed metrics.

warnings.title: Record identity is stronger than the reduced text key
warnings.details: Each epoch has 9508 consecutive unique row indices but 9506 unique (scan_id,target_id,utterance_sha256) tuples. Two repeated normalized identity groups are recorded. Annotation IDs/raw dataset membership were not independently checked. Pairing by row index plus the saved identities and GT is exact across epochs; 8915/8995 query-slot changes do not mean instance-identity changes.

warnings.title: A dormant metric helper does not substantiate an additional result
warnings.details: calculate_diou_3d is defined in losses.py but its loss_boxes invocation is commented out. The primary last/bbs IoU path is active and its outputs are present. No DIoU training/evaluation effect is supported by these artifacts.

warnings.title: Update count is corroborated by terminal history and source arithmetic
warnings.details: 9166 equals two completed epochs times 4583 batches with one optimizer.step per batch. This audit did not inspect the retired latest optimizer-state counters, so it is not an independent state-based update recount.

actions: Keep the saved-only, single-control, and historical-runtime qualifiers when reporting these results.
Do not promote scalar candidate coverage to independently reconstructed all256 performance.
Keep content reconstruction, byte copy, and cold execution recovery as separate statuses.
